subject: Private VPC pricing qualification - token volumes & support tiers
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Gupta <amit@fintechco.com>, Riya Shah <riya.shah@fintechco.com>
Cc: FintechCo Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Private VPC discovery call - next steps

Hi Amit / Riya -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and the ask for next steps so we can scope pricing and licensing: 

- Use case: customer-facing credit decisioning and internally-run fraud scoring (PII stays in your VPC).
- Expected models: Redwood-hosted open models (gpt-family equivalents) deployed into a Private VPC in your AWS account.
- Environments: prod + staging initially; potential sandbox for data science (so 2-3 environments).
- Throughput: ~300 concurrent requests at peak, average prompt+response length ~1.2k tokens.
- Token volume estimate: baseline 150M tokens/month, scaling to ~1B tokens/month in 12 months depending on rollout.
- Budget range: initial target $/1M tokens in the low hundreds (you mentioned $200-600 per 1M as a target range) - need to confirm precise target.

Can you confirm the token volume bands (monthly) you think are realistic today vs 12 months out, and the target $/1M tokens you want us to price to? Also confirm the desired support tier (standard vs enterprise with 24/7 + named SRE).

Attached is a short note on the licensing model options (term license + reserved capacity vs per-token + managed support). I'll put a pricing sketch together once we lock volumes and environment count.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_private_pricing_v1.pdf - 56KB)

From: Amit Gupta <amit@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Riya Shah <riya.shah@fintechco.com>, FintechCo Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC discovery call - next steps

Ben -

Thanks for the summary, that aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Token volumes: current pilot is closer to 40-60M tokens/month. If we roll out to all customers in Q4, we expect ~600-900M tokens/month (conservative) and ~1B+ in best case. So please price for bands: 0-50M, 50-200M, 200-600M, 600M-1B, >1B.

2) Target unit economics: leadership is looking for something in the $300-400 / 1M tokens range for the 200-600M band. They said higher for low-volume bands is acceptable if reserved capacity reduces unit cost at scale.

3) Environments: Start with prod + staging. Sandbox is nice-to-have but not required on day 1. If sandbox adds material licensing/support cost, we might defer.

4) Security: procurement will request SOC2 evidence and a standard security questionnaire - I've looped procurement on this thread.

Can you provide a pricing sketch and an option that shows reserved capacity (monthly commit) vs pure usage? Also include support tiers and what's included in enterprise SLA (SRE on-call, faster response, playbooks).

-Amit

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Gupta <amit@fintechco.com>, Riya Shah <riya.shah@fintechco.com>
Cc: FintechCo Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-23T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Private VPC discovery call - next steps

Amit - great, thanks for the clearer bands. Attached is a quick pricing sketch and a short matrix that compares:

A) Reserved capacity (monthly commit) + license fee - lower $/1M at scale, predictable spend, includes 2 environments (prod/staging).
B) Usage-based private (no commit) + platform license - higher unit rate for low volumes, flexible; sandbox charged as an add-on environment.

Highlights in the attachment:
- Band pricing for 0-50M, 50-200M, 200-600M, 600M-1B, >1B tokens.
- Example: Reserved commit of 500M/mo + enterprise support -> effective unit ~$320 / 1M tokens (includes reserved discount + baseline license amortization).
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 24x5), Enterprise (24x7, named SRE, quarterly runbooks), Premium (dedicated engineering hours for onboarding).

I added two scenarios on slide 2 showing how adding a sandbox environment impacts monthly license amortization (typically increases by ~10-15% unless included in commit).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm which pricing scenario you want (A vs B) and the commit band you consider for the first 6-12 months.
2) Procurement to send security questionnaire - Marissa / Dev can coordinate SOC2 evidence and environment onboarding requirements.
3) If you want, we can issue a draft SOW + Term Sheet for internal review (I included a proto SOW as SOW-draft-fintechco.docx).

(attachment: redwood_private_pricing_v1.pdf - 56KB)
(attachment: SOW-draft-fintechco.docx - 24KB)

Thanks - I’ll follow up with a one-page summary for leadership once you pick a scenario.

Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Gupta <amit@fintechco.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, FintechCo Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC discovery call - next steps

Hi Amit -

Quick note on support and onboarding costs from our side: 

- Standard support includes onboarding docs, 8x5 support, and up to 3 onboarding calls.
- Enterprise support includes a named SRE, runbook creation, and a 2-week onboarding engagement (remote). We price the onboarding engagement as a one-time professional services fee or roll it into the first-year commit.
- Environment count: we typically treat additional isolated environments as separate instances for licensing purposes (unless covered under a committed capacity deal). Many customers include a sandbox as part of the commit to simplify ops.

If you want, Dev and I can scope the SRE onboarding hours and provide a firm number for the SOW so procurement has clarity on one-time vs recurring costs.

-Marissa

From: Amit Gupta <amit@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Cc: FintechCo Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>, Riya Shah <riya.shah@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC discovery call - next steps

Thanks team - this is helpful. We're comfortable starting with Scenario A (reserved commit) and looking at a 6-12 month initial commit in the 500M/month band if the $320 / 1M example holds. Procurement will review the SOW and security items - I'll aim to get the questionnaire back by next Wed.

Next actions we need from Redwood: 
- Send a 1-page pricing summary for leadership (clean numbers for the 0-50M, 50-200M, 200-600M, 600M-1B bands)
- Draft SOW showing onboarding hours and whether onboarding is one-time PS fee or included in year-1 commit
- Provide SOC2 evidence link and point person for technical security Qs (Dev listed as point).

If you can get those to us by EOD Friday we'll circulate internally and aim to have a procurement readout next Tuesday.

-Amit
